name: Ananya Reddy
quote: Honestly? I came for the ambience and stayed for the food. The lamb shank was fall-off-the-bone perfection, and the cocktails are some of the best I've had in Hyderabad. Already planning my next visit.

name: Vikram Sen
quote: The rooftop embers experience in Hyderabad is unmatched. By focusing on pure soil harvests and wood fire, they've set a premium benchmark for contemporary Indian dining.
